item.title: Legacy and Innovation in Pharmaceutical Machinery
item.description:
Legacy and Innovation in Pharmaceutical Machinery
#

Established in 1982, CHIN YI MACHINERY CO., LTD. has built a reputation as a specialized manufacturer of capsule filling machines in Taiwan. Guided by a commitment to excellent quality, attentive service, and continuous research and development, the company has experienced consistent growth over the decades.

item.title: Pharmaceutical Innovation and Manufacturing at INTERPHEX 2021
item.description:
Pharmaceutical Innovation and Manufacturing at INTERPHEX 2021
#

The International Pharmaceutical Expo (INTERPHEX) stands as a premier event for professionals in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. Dedicated to innovation, technology, and knowledge sharing, INTERPHEX brings together global industry leaders, suppliers, and professionals to address the most pressing challenges in product development and manufacturing.
